intent: Edit six existing Soviet poster people into complete HOI4 conscription law icons; preserve original material frame during final native-size packaging.

assets.detail: Use the red-capped moustached 1920 Red Army volunteer pointing DIRECTLY AT THE VIEWER. Frontal gaze, stern long face, red cap with star, pointing hand clearly foreground, chest-up composition. This is the volunteer enlistment stage.
assets.prompt:
Edit the supplied Soviet poster person into ONE complete Hearts of Iron IV conscription-law UI medallion. Reference 1 is the specific poster person and must remain recognizable: preserve their original face, age, headwear, gaze and gesture rather than substituting a generic face. Reference 2 supplies the dark silver metal circular frame; reference 3 supplies actual native game icon style and scale. Match the old HOI4 law icons: dark aged oil/printed illustration, muted olive, warm brown and restrained red, strong chiaroscuro, slightly soft and grainy at small game size, simple readable silhouette, NOT photoreal, NOT glossy modern render, NOT an anime character, NOT an identical handsome soldier template. Produce a complete centered circular medal with metallic rim BEHIND the figure, round interior filled with the poster composition, transparent outside; no square paper background, no text, no writing, no title, no symbols floating outside. The rim must not obscure the face or hands. Approximately 85% of the square canvas used by the medallion, no large margins. Native icon is 64x64: prioritize the person over tiny details.
Use the red-capped moustached 1920 Red Army volunteer pointing DIRECTLY AT THE VIEWER. Frontal gaze, stern long face, red cap with star, pointing hand clearly foreground, chest-up composition. This is the volunteer enlistment stage.

assets.detail: Use the rugged worker in the large black cloth cap, black moustache and black jacket from the BOOK FAIR poster. A mature civilian worker with a broad asymmetric dark face, turned slightly toward the LEFT of the image, keep this worker's original grin and cap. Tight head and shoulders, partly warm ochre shirt, no books and no text. This is the territorial/reserve militia stage.
